user.title: Heating Queue Manager
user.description: Configure the maximum number of simultaneous heating reservations.

request.name: Request slot
request.description: Request a FIFO reservation; does not switch a relay.

relay_entity_id.name: Relay entity
relay_entity_id.description: Light or switch powering this heater.

release.name: Release slot
release.description: Release a reservation only if Home Assistant reports its relay OFF.

cancel.name: Cancel request
cancel.description: Remove a waiting request or release an OFF reservation.

resume.name: Resume queue after restart
resume.description: Verify all known relay states and re-enable FIFO requests. Inspect heating equipment before resuming.

init.title: Supervised relays
init.description: Select supervised relays and the maximum number of simultaneous reservations. Active and waiting bookings remain protected.

error.relays_in_use: Cannot exclude a relay with an active or waiting reservation. Release or cancel it first.
error.storage_unavailable: Cannot read saved bookings. Configuration unchanged.
error.max_active_below_reserved: Cannot reduce the limit below the number of currently active reservations.
